spans.s:
जिगत्नु m. (-त्रुः) Breath, life.
 E. गम् to go, to depart, कत्नुच् Uṇādi affix,
and the radical repeated. प्राणवायौ ।

जिगमिषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing or endeavouring to go.
 E. गम् to
go, desiderative form, शतृ aff.

जिगमिषा f. (-षा) Wish to go or move.
 E. गम् to go, desider. form, अङ्
टाप् affs.

जिगमिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to go.
 E. गम् to go, desiderative form, उ aff.

जिगरिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to take, to lay hold of, to take away.
E. गृ to seize, desiderative form, उ aff.

जिगीषा f. (-षा)
 1. Emulation, wish to excel or overcome.
 2. Eminence.
[]
3. Usage, profession or habit of life.
 E. जि to conquer, in the desi-
derative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

जिगीषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Striving to overcome, vieing or contending with.
E. जि to conquer; desiderative form, affix उ.
